title: Relative projective-line automorphisms preserve the hyperplane class modulo base lines
statement: Let S be any scheme and q:P=ProjectiveLine S -> S its standard projective line [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. For an isomorphism a:P≅P with a.hom followed by q equal to q, there exists B in Pic(S) [def-sc-picard-group] such that a* [O_P(1)] = q* B times [O_P(1)] in Pic(P) with the tensor group law [lem-sc-pic-group], with O_P(1) the actual standard projective twist [def-pc-projective-space-twist] and Picard pullback as in [lem-pc-pic-presheaf-functorial]. No hypotheses of nonemptiness, reducedness, connectedness, or Noetherianity are imposed.

source.place: Remark 4.2.7, printed p.75, degree one and tautological line under a projective-bundle isomorphism. Arbitrary-base extension by projective-bundle Picard classification using Stacks Tag 0B8W; field degree normalization by the monomial cohomology formula. Also the generic change-of-model step of lem-sfb-diagonal-trace-diagonal-pic.

proof.text: For any base map g:T→S, use the standard projective-space pullback square to lift a and its inverse to maps of ProjectiveLine T over T. Their compositions are identities by the two pullback projections, so they form an automorphism b; its square with a and the projective-space base-change map commutes.

Put H=[O(1)]. For every s:S apply the preceding construction to the canonical map Spec kappa(s)→S. The projective twist base-change isomorphism identifies the restriction of H with the actual fibre O(1). The field automorphism theorem shows that the fibre automorphism fixes this class. Functoriality of Picard pullback and its group law show that a*H times H inverse restricts to 1 on every residue-field fibre.
Apply the fibrewise trivial descent lemma to L=a*H times H inverse, obtaining B with q*B=L. Multiply by H and cancel H inverse times H to obtain a*H=q*B times H, the original conclusion unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Remark 4.2.7, printed p.75. M4 formal reduction through the fibrewise trivial ratio. Field degree is determined directly by h0, without the intermediate ±1 group-automorphism argument. The remaining generic degree-zero descent is stated separately.

lean.statement:
theorem automorphism_hyperplane (S : Scheme.{u})
    (a : ProjectiveLine S ≅ ProjectiveLine S)
    (ha : a.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) = (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)) :
    ∃ B : S.Pic,
      Scheme.Pic.map a.hom
          (Scheme.Pic.ofIsInvertible (ProjectiveSpace.twist (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) S 1)) =
        Scheme.Pic.map (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) B *
          Scheme.Pic.ofIsInvertible (ProjectiveSpace.twist (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) S 1)
